prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 40.3 °C (30% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 44.8 °C (24% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 47.1 °C (21% above healthy). Thermal dissipation is sub-optimal, allowing gradual temperature elevation during continuous load cycles.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.70 s (5% above healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.42 l/min (2% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 385 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.5 % (4% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.9 bar (within 1% of healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.
